summary: This resolution condemns the persecution of Christians in Nigeria, expresses support for President Trump to take action, and calls on the U.S. government to use diplomatic and economic tools to pressure Nigeria to end violence, protect Christians, facilitate the return of displaced persons, and repeal blasphemy laws.
